cards.name: Woodland Champion
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.

rulings.comment: The number of +1/+1 counters you put on Woodland Champion is the number of tokens that entered the battlefield under your control, even if some or all of them leave the battlefield before the triggered ability resolves.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
